tools.file.changed.text: The file no longer matches its recorded read. Inspect the current contents before attempting a write.

tools.file.complete_read.text: Write requires a complete Read of the existing file. Read its full contents before replacing it; use Edit for a targeted change based on a partial view.

tools.file.edit_read.text: Edit needs a recorded Read of this file. Read the target, then prepare old_string from the returned source text and retry.

tools.file.write_limit.text: File exceeds the {limit} byte limit. Use a streaming command to process larger files.

tools.file.regular_only.text: Only regular files can be read

tools.file.read_limit.text: File exceeds the {limit} byte read limit. Use a streaming command to select a smaller portion.

tools.file.grew.text: File grew while being read. Obtain a fresh, complete view before changing this file.

tools.file.identical_edit.text: Edit rejected identical old_string and new_string values. Supply different replacement text, or omit this edit if no change is needed.

tools.file.empty.text: <system-reminder>This file is empty; there are no lines to display.</system-reminder>

tools.file.changed_after_edit.text: Note: the file changed again after this edit. Re-read it before further changes.

tools.file.refresh_failed.text: The read state could not be refreshed. Read the file again before further changes.

tools.file.invalid_offset.text: offset must be a nonnegative integer

tools.file.invalid_limit.text: limit must be a positive integer

tools.file.denied.text: Permission to read {path} has been denied.

tools.file.directory.text: {path} is a directory, not a file. Use Bash with `ls` to list directory contents.

tools.file.beyond_end.text: <system-reminder>Requested line {offset} is beyond this file's {total} lines. Choose an offset within that range.</system-reminder>

tools.file.line_truncated.text: ... (line {line} was truncated because it exceeds the character budget.)

tools.file.more_lines.text: ... (showing lines {start}-{end} of {total}. Use offset={offset} to continue reading.)

tools.file.no_match.text:
Edit found no literal match for old_string. Read the target again and copy the intended passage with its original spaces, tabs, and line breaks; exclude displayed line numbers. No replacement was made.
Unmatched old_string: {old}

tools.file.ambiguous_edit.text:
The edit is ambiguous: old_string occurs {count} times. Include enough adjacent source text to select one occurrence, or set replace_all=true if every occurrence should change.
old_string: {old}

tools.file.image_invalid.text: Cannot attach image {path}: the file is empty, invalid, or incomplete. No image was attached. Use a valid PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file.

tools.file.image_limit.text: Image file is too large ({megabytes} MB). Maximum supported size is 5 MB. Consider resizing or compressing the image before reading.

tools.file.image_unsupported.text: [Image file: {path}. This format cannot be delivered for visual analysis; convert it to PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP.]

tools.file.image_captured.text: [Image file: {path}. The image content has been captured for visual analysis.]

tools.file.pdf_guidance.text: No PDF text or images were extracted. Changing pages on Read will not extract contents. Use an available PDF-capable tool or a local text extractor; scanned pages need OCR.

tools.file.pdf_limit.text: PDF size is {size} bytes; Read accepts up to 104857600 bytes (100 MiB). {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_invalid_pages.text: Invalid PDF page selection: pages must be a string containing a positive safe integer or an ascending inclusive range, such as "2" or "2-4". {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_too_many_pages.text: Requested {count} pages; the selection limit is 20. Split the selection into ranges of at most 20 pages: start with "{start}-{end}", then continue from page {next}. {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_selection.text: Requested pages: {selection}. The document's page count has not been checked.

tools.file.state_key_type.text: File state keys must be strings

tools.file.state_property_type.text: File state property must be a string

tools.file.state_unavailable.text: External file read state is no longer available
